topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can hardly believe what happened when I came home today. My car, which has been sitting peacefully in my driveway for days, was gone. Its usual spot was now just a patch of unremarkable concrete, as if mocking me with its emptiness. I paced the curb, checking every angle, hoping I’d somehow overlooked it. Then I spotted the note, a tiny piece of paper on the ground, an explanation that seemed too absurd to be true. My car had been towed, just like that, from where it’s been for as long as I’ve owned this place. The logistics, the audacity of it all, left me standing there, the weight of the situation settling in around me.
